v1_compatibility.notes: New Operations endpoints do not alter any existing frozen v1 endpoint, request, response, ledger, or gameplay behavior.

response_policy.degraded: readiness uses OPERATIONS_NOT_READY while Admin receives sanitized degraded data
response_policy.unexpected: standard ok/error envelope with OPERATIONS_PROBE_FAILED and fixed backend reason details
response_policy.down: inferred by clients from transport failure or stale heartbeat because a down process cannot answer

forbidden_diagnostics: credentials, tokens, DSNs, hosts, or database names
shared_integration_required: contract matrix, digest, and validator discovery
central API, browser, visual, and copied-deployment smoke coverage
